'''''Cichorium pumilum''''' is a [[Mediterranean]] species of plant in the tribe [[Cichorieae]] within the family [[Asteraceae]]. Like the other species of ''[[Cichorium]]'', its leaves are edible by humans. The plant produces bluish-violet [[flower heads]] and fleshy [[taproots]].<ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=cichorium+pumilum Altervista Flora Italiana, Endivia selvatica, ''Cichorium pumilum'' Jacq.]</ref>
